name: PADME
full_name: Positron Annihilation into Dark Matter Experiment
summary: PADME is a dedicated positron-annihilation dark-sector experiment at the DAΦNE Beam Test Facility, INFN Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati.
detection_principle: Positrons strike electrons in a thin target to seek a missing-mass peak in e⁺e⁻→γA′; positron-energy scans can also test resonant production of new particles in e⁺e⁻ annihilation.

results.summary: Published an e⁺e⁻→γγ cross-section measurement validating a Standard Model process.
The collaboration continues to report X17 searches and upgrades; nuclear-physics anomalies motivating them must not be described as a dark-matter discovery.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
